item.description:
Clearer settings and AI connections

  • Settings now has larger labels, clearer section headers, and a focused layout with less visual clutter.
  • Find Cloud sync and Privacy directly in the sidebar. Collapse or expand all settings, including updates and cloud sync.
  • Integrations guides you through choosing an account, selecting a model version, and testing it before saving your default.
  • Connection details and future integrations stay tucked away until you need them.

An optional cloud copy of recent mail

  • Private pilot accounts can enable Cloud sync in Settings. Your Mac mirrors up to 1,000 downloaded emails from the last 30 days, including labels and Jev results.
  • See sync progress, pause uploads, or remove the cloud copy. Cloud sync starts off and requires your Google sign-in and consent.
  • Drafts, attachments, Spam, Trash and Google refresh tokens stay out of the cloud mirror. Large bodies are shortened.
  • This is the foundation for mobile access. Sync still runs while Cove is open on your Mac; a mobile app and server-side Gmail retrieval are not included yet.

Your calendar, at a glance

  • The weekly calendar opens near the current time. Today returns to the current day and time, while selecting an event brings its time into view.
  • Choose Month to see a full monthly calendar. Select a day for its agenda, open event previews, or use “more” to see a busy day’s full schedule.
  • Month navigation and Google Calendar sync cover every visible day, including dates from adjacent months.
